intro: Dalar's Analysis is a Horde quest in Silverpine Forest linking Shadow Priest Allister's espionage against Ambermill with the arcane research of Dalar Dawnweaver. After uncovering a rune-inscribed pendant from a Dalaran supply crate, adventurers bring the relic to Dalar at the Sepulcher for scrutiny. The artifact reveals that the surviving mages of Dalaran are marshaling significant magical power for a hidden initiative.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Take the pendant to Dalar Dawnweaver, perhaps he can shed some light on the wizards' plans.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Interesting, more machinations of the Kirin Tor, it would seem. This is a powerful artifact. It was used frequently by powerful wizards of the Kirin Tor to channel magical energies.
That they are delivering so many to Ambermill indicates that they must be undergoing a project of some magnitude.
I will see if I can pierce their shields and ascertain their intent.
